messages.subject: Meeting this Thursday, 10-12, Datalab Classroom
parts:
Welcome back, D-RUGgies! 

With the fall quarter beginning, we will be meeting in person and virtually this Thursday from 10-noon (note that the day of the week has changed). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. We will also discuss topics for the 2024-25 school year so please bring ideas and questions, or email them in advance. We R looking forward to seeing you all again!

Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
